tasks.notes: HIGHEST silent-loss risk in the backlog. Five Canvas hard gates reach their policy through drive_local_workflow("local-canvas-build"), a name §8.3 deletes — exactly 1 call site at lap/baseline. Merging the workflows without re-entering the policy makes five gates vanish with every test still green. Exit criterion: the call-site count reaches 0 AND both named functions still exist (builtins.rs:1944 and :2509 at lap/baseline). If the count hits 0 and the functions are gone, the gates were deleted, not migrated — anchor on function names, never line numbers. Separately, render_check.status="not_applicable" has NO behavioural test today: builtins.rs:2263 pins a schema-description string, which is copy-pinning, not a gate. That case is net-new, not a migration.
